title: Secondary school districts, 2026
description: The 'School District-Secondary' layer of the 2026 TIGER/Line School Districts National GeoPackage: 472 rows, of which 472 areas in 19 states and territories. Columns and values unchanged; 2D geometry in NAD83 (EPSG:4269) with a bbox covering, Hilbert-sorted, as one GeoParquet 2.0 file read in place over HTTPS or the anonymous S3 endpoint s3.geomermaids.com, and a PMTiles archive for web maps. The Census Bureau makes no warranty on the accuracy of TIGER/Line, and its boundaries are for statistical data collection and tabulation only: not a determination of jurisdictional authority, ownership or entitlement, and not legal land descriptions. Credit: U.S. Census Bureau, TIGER/Line 2026.

providers.name: U.S. Census Bureau, Geography Division
providers.description: Produces TIGER/Line from its MAF/TIGER system and publishes it as national GeoPackages. A US government work, not subject to copyright in the United States.

providers.name: Geomermaids
providers.description: Converted the GeoPackage layers to GeoParquet, tiled them, and maintains and hosts this catalog and its data.

table:columns.name: SCSDLEA
table:columns.description: Secondary school district local education agency (LEA) code.

table:columns.name: GEOID
table:columns.description: Area identifier: the codes of the areas it nests in, then its own code (e.g. state + county + tract for a tract).

table:columns.name: GEOIDFQ
table:columns.description: Fully qualified GEOID, used to join data tables from data.census.gov.

table:columns.name: LOGRADE
table:columns.description: Lowest grade covered by the school district.

table:columns.name: HIGRADE
table:columns.description: Highest grade covered by the school district.

table:columns.name: MTFCC
table:columns.description: MAF/TIGER feature class code, the kind of area (e.g. G5200 congressional district, G4020 county, G5020 census tract).

table:columns.name: INTPTLAT
table:columns.description: Latitude of the internal point (text, as published).

table:columns.name: INTPTLON
table:columns.description: Longitude of the internal point (text, as published).

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Area outline as native Parquet GEOMETRY (WKB), NAD83 (EPSG:4269), longitude and latitude, 2D.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: STRUCT(xmin FLOAT, ymin FLOAT, xmax FLOAT, ymax FLOAT)
table:columns.description: Per-row bounding box (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), declared as the GeoParquet covering. Filter on it to prune row groups.

data.title: Secondary school districts, 2026
data.description: 472 rows in 3 row groups of at most 4 MiB of geometry.

pmtiles.title: Secondary school districts, vector tiles
pmtiles.description: PMTiles, layer `scsd`, zoom 0 to 12, 18,505 tiles; properties STATEFP, SCSDLEA, GEOID, NAME, LOGRADE, HIGRADE, ALAND, AWATER, color_index (color_index: a colour per area such that neighbours differ). Built with tylertoo 0.8.0.
